accessibilityNodes.name: Heavy Hand
accessibilityNodes.effect: Your Crush attacks deal +2 raw damage.

accessibilityNodes.name: Follow Through
accessibilityNodes.effect: Deal +3 raw damage to a foe with 8 or more armour before the hit.

accessibilityNodes.name: Overbear
accessibilityNodes.effect: Make a heavy Crush attack now, then skip your next personal turn.

accessibilityNodes.name: Bracing Stance
accessibilityNodes.effect: Deal +3 raw damage while you have held the same rank since your previous action.

accessibilityNodes.name: Stagger
accessibilityNodes.effect: Landed Crush hits have a 30% chance to move the foe one place later next round.

accessibilityNodes.name: Shatter
accessibilityNodes.effect: Strike one foe and permanently reduce its armour for this encounter, to a minimum of 0.

accessibilityNodes.name: Momentum
accessibilityNodes.effect: Gain raw damage from gear initiative penalty: 40% of the penalty, rounded down, maximum +4.

accessibilityNodes.name: Breaking Blow
accessibilityNodes.effect: Crush hits ignore armour; the first landed Crush hit each personal turn also Staggers.

accessibilityNodes.name: Keen Eye
accessibilityNodes.effect: Your Pierce attacks deal +2 raw damage.

accessibilityNodes.name: Weak Point
accessibilityNodes.effect: Deal +3 raw damage when the foe's covering density is 50 or more.

accessibilityNodes.name: Pry
accessibilityNodes.effect: Make a lower-power Pierce attack that ignores armour.

accessibilityNodes.name: Steady Hand
accessibilityNodes.effect: Landed attacks have a 12% chance to deal ×1.5 raw damage before armour.

accessibilityNodes.name: Exploit
accessibilityNodes.effect: Deal +4 raw damage to a foe with Burn, Poison, Dazzle or Bleed.

accessibilityNodes.name: Finish
accessibilityNodes.effect: Strike one foe at full power below the shown HP threshold, or one-third power above it.

accessibilityNodes.name: Anatomy
accessibilityNodes.effect: The party gains 35% more butchery output while you took part in the expedition; copies do not stack.

accessibilityNodes.name: Killing Stroke
accessibilityNodes.effect: Defeat a surviving non-apex foe at 15% HP or less after your hit; apexes take +4 damage instead.

accessibilityNodes.name: Quick Step
accessibilityNodes.effect: Gain +4 initiative.

accessibilityNodes.name: Light Touch
accessibilityNodes.effect: Halve initiative penalties from equipped gear, rounding toward 0.

accessibilityNodes.name: Quicken
accessibilityNodes.effect: As zero-turn setup, take two ordinary actions now, then skip your next personal turn; cannot combine with Blur.

accessibilityNodes.name: Second Wind
accessibilityNodes.effect: When you defeat a foe, recover 3 HP if still conscious.

accessibilityNodes.name: Flurry
accessibilityNodes.effect: A landed direct attack carries 40% of damage dealt to one other legal foe; it cannot chain.

accessibilityNodes.name: First Strike
accessibilityNodes.effect: As your first normal-cost action, attack for +4 raw damage without allowing retaliation.

accessibilityNodes.name: Cascade
accessibilityNodes.effect: Each foe you defeat grants +3 initiative for this encounter, up to three times.

accessibilityNodes.name: Blur
accessibilityNodes.effect: Once per encounter, take two ordinary actions without spending this action; cannot combine with Quicken this turn.
